document_title: Witness Statement under CrPC 161: Alok Saxena

statements.text: I state that I met Vikram Singh at Blue Tokai Coffee in Connaught Place on the morning of 22 September 2026 at approximately 09:00 AM. We remained seated discussing business consulting till 10:15 AM. Vikram never left the table.

investigator_note: Statement provides affirmative alibi for suspect Vikram Singh during the key fraud and transport window (09:15 - 09:45). Contradicts ANPR toll sighting at DND Toll at 09:41 and cell tower pings in South Delhi.
